_comment: Copy to routes.json (gitignored). Any value written as env:VAR_NAME is read from the environment, so no token or webhook URL is ever committed.

discord._mode: 'webhook' needs nothing but URLs and works in two minutes, but has no buttons. 'bot' needs a bot token and a public interactions URL, and lets coaches action a case with one click.
discord._channels: Right-click a Discord channel with Developer Mode on to Copy Channel ID.

leapagencyuk@gmail.com._userId: A user ID sends the card as a direct message instead of to a channel.

example-webhook-coach@leap._webhook: A channel webhook URL. Used in preference to channelId, so a single coach can be moved to webhook mode without changing anything else.
